businesses.business: industrial IoT and edge networking hardware and software

offering_description.value: Designs and sells IoT connectivity products such as serial-to-Ethernet device servers, console servers, out-of-band management, embedded modules, gateways and routers, plus edge AI compute and video/IoT software. Customers are OEMs, enterprises, IT data centers and industrial operators. Products are designed in-house and built by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: out-of-band management and console servers; IoT gateways and routers; embedded IoT modules; serial device servers; edge AI compute and video surveillance products

primary_services.value: cloud device management software subscriptions; technical support and maintenance contracts; engineering design services

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs, enterprise IT and data center operators, industrial and telecom companies, system integrators; B2G: government and defense agencies

end_markets.value: data centers and IT infrastructure; industrial automation; transportation and smart cities; healthcare; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: product sales: hardware devices and embedded modules sold to OEMs, resellers and enterprises; subscription: cloud management and software subscriptions; service fees: support, maintenance and engineering services

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs branded IoT hardware built by contract manufacturers, sold to OEMs, enterprises and channel partners; software / platform: management and edge software sold to customers using its devices

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, headquartered in Irvine, California

specialization.value: related lines: connectivity hardware, edge compute, embedded modules and management software for IoT

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: technology distributors and value-added resellers; direct sales: OEM and large enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: system integrators and channel partners; online: e-commerce web store
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: wireless and electronics certifications such as FCC and CE, export controls, product safety, and trade or tariff rules
